pages.title: Pleroma Reconstitutor
pages.text: A cathedral of Absolute Frame and Pleroma Glass around a Logos-wound throat. Fed the Echo of the Transcendental and everything the Sundering left, it plays the echo back - until the dimension it remembers exists again.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.
Runs once: fed the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), it rebuilds the Transcendental. Only works while the Transcendental is destroyed.

pages.name: Pleroma Reconstitutor
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Crystal of Transcendence, Omnipotent Ingot, Rekindled Spark, Shard of Omnipotence.
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(): Eschaton Foundry, Rekindled Spark
